annotation.title_en: Rules of Procedure of the Parliament of Thailand B.E. 2563 (2020), as amended (No. 2) B.E. 2568 (2025)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: รัฐสภา (Parliament of Thailand)
annotation.summary_en: Thai Parliament's Rules of Procedure (2020), as amended in 2025, governing joint sittings: presiding officers, agendas, motions, debate, voting, committees, organic bills, and general debate. The file does not match its collector title about a Gen AI seminar and has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets procedures for joint sittings of the National Assembly, including agendas, motions, debate and voting.
Regulates committees' fact-finding and public disclosure of their reports.
Sets the three-reading process for organic bills.
Amended by Amendment No. 2 (2025), e.g. on electronic notice of meetings.
Contains no AI or robotics provisions; the collector title (Gen AI seminar) does not match the content.
